item.title: Soma 1.0 (651)
item.description:
Soma 1.0 (651)

  • New Hierarchy in People & Teams: drag teams onto a canvas, connect them to show who reports to whom, and add labelled boxes to group teams. Drag the background to move around; ⌘-scroll or pinch to zoom.
  • Export a hierarchy to a file and import it again, here or on another Mac. Importing adds any teams and people that are missing, and merges teams with the same name.
  • Star the people you work with often. They’re listed under Regular Contacts, and Soma suggests them first when you pick people.
  • People & Teams’ sidebar sections now open and close.
  • Edit the list of functions in Settings › People.
  • Cisco people show the Cisco logo on their card.
  • On iPhone and iPad: teams in People, a format bar above the keyboard in notes, pull down to search, and tap a note’s image to see it full screen.

Soma is still in beta testing. Keep backups on (Settings › Backups).

item.title: Soma 1.0 (600)
item.description:
Soma 1.0 (600)

  • The people picker has People, Teams and Groups tabs, and you can add a team anywhere you add people.
  • A person’s page now shows the work of the groups they’re in.
  • Added appearance styles: 11 light and 10 dark, each with its own accent colour, including Soft White and Soft Dusk.

Soma is still in beta testing. Keep backups on (Settings › Backups).
